decision.primary_metric: complete entry seconds; do not reuse the SQL primary-only adoption gate
decision.required: All scientific/source/safety/accounting tests pass and resource limits hold. Publish all pair values regardless of outcome; failure means not adopted.
decision.interpretation: Frozen engineering screening criteria, not a statistical generalization guarantee or premeasured speedup.

activation.gate: Commit this specification, then unchanged V28 entry/core/tests must pass integrated synthetic acceptance and be committed before --measure.

execution.topology: One V5 supervisor covers pipeline, worker and later independent publisher under the same absolute deadline.
execution.worker: Original full source closure before/after; original48 R/C warmups and six RC/CR pairs sequentially,14 fresh stores; same V27 bytecode and fine observers on both arms.
execution.context: Complete ordered original15 binding, entire closure including all596 original identities and new methods/evidence, four exact dependency descriptors, all original semantic and accepted C1/entry method descriptors, environment and complete model/config in key. One cold build then six hits.
execution.source_checks: Both original create and forced post-OS-lock full binding checks per run; all four worker/publisher closure boundaries and14 original publisher opens remain.
execution.publisher: New interpreter after normal worker exit. Freshly read original model receipt/counts/catalog; independently rebuild context and compare digest/rows/bytes to raw cache.use events. No worker snapshot passed or deserialized.
execution.evidence: Publisher audits complete physical frames, scientific bytes, SQL workload, costs/events/telemetry and cold+six hits; seals evidence after normal child exit, then outer normal completion and stopped identities are required for public release.
execution.timing: No synthetic padding or hidden preloading. All C1 guards remain in complete entry. Original setup and primary separate from post-verifier guard; cold warmup retained in seven-run sums. Publisher callback/process and public serialization separate.
execution.restart: Single exclusive unique request. Existing failed/completed namespace rejects new measurement; --release only re-audits an already completed window.
execution.telemetry: Frozen V18 200ms target sampler around every full entry and publisher; preserve raw brackets/gaps and sequential nonoverlap, observe Ollama names only.

acceptance.scope: V28 real-contract and real-bytecode worker/publisher/release tested on artificial48 with actual child processes, plus complete V27 73-case regression. No real rankings before receipt.
